description: This PHP class defines the ProjectMilestone model within the Goteo project, providing methods for retrieving, validating, saving, and deleting project milestone data from a database.

classes.name: ProjectMilestone
classes.description: Represents a milestone related to a project, with methods for CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific ProjectMilestone based on project ID and post ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all milestones associated with a specific project, optionally localized.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the milestone has either a blog post or milestone type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current milestone, generating a milestone if necessary, and handling errors.

methods.name: removePostMilestone
methods.description: Deletes the association between a project and a post milestone.
